snippet.title: Eastern Era | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Become a sect leader in Eastern Era – a martial arts-themed management simulation game.

A realistic 3D martial arts-themed management simulation game is now available.

The mountain gate is open. Young Heroes, will you join our sect and forge a legend in the martial world with us?
